children: Pulse Biosciences completed enrollment of 100 patients in the PRECISE-BTN study and the first patient finished the 12-month follow-up.
Enrollment expanded from 50 to 100 patients and was completed across three U.S. sites in ~12 months.
The first patient enrolled completed the final 12-month follow-up visit in August.
Study evaluates nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System for symptomatic benign thyroid nodules.
Endpoints include safety, targeted nodule volume reduction, symptom relief, hormone normalization, and quality-of-life improvements.
Preliminary data will be presented at an upcoming medical society conference; full data expected after all 12-month follow-ups.
